# Linehaul.ai

> Linehaul.ai is an AI-powered freight brokerage specializing in Truckload, Drop Trailers, and Drayage container services. We streamline logistics operations using advanced technology, focusing on efficiency, real-time visibility, predictive insights, and strong customer/carrier relationships.

We combine AI, supply chain visibility APIs, and seamless software integration with genuine human interaction and common sense. Our core values emphasize transparent accountability, efficiency, proactive communication, mutual success, professional equity, and innovation. Our mission is to enhance the logistics experience through technology while maintaining accessible, dedicated support.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://linehaul.ai/): Overview of services, AI features, and company focus.
- [About](https://linehaul.ai/about): Company mission, vision, values, and executive team.
- [Load Tracking](https://linehaul.ai/load-track): Portal for real-time shipment tracking.
- [Blog](https://linehaul.ai/blog): Latest news, updates, and insights from Linehaul.ai.
- [Freight Glossary](https://linehaul.ai/freight-glossary): Definitions for freight, logistics, and trucking terminology.

## Services

- [Truckload](https://linehaul.ai/#service-stack): Dry Van, Refrigerated, & Team Expedited freight services.
- [Drop Trailers](https://linehaul.ai/#service-stack): Nationwide Trailerpool Network (DROP-IT®) for joint-capacity solutions.
- [Drayage](https://linehaul.ai/#service-stack): Optimized port-to-dock container moves with real-time tracking.

## Key Features

- [Real-time Tracking & Transparency](https://linehaul.ai/load-track): Live truck location (Dispatched to Delivered) via Laneweaver TMS APIs.
- [Predictive Delivery Insights](https://linehaul.ai/): Machine Learning to foresee delays and optimize dock efficiency.
- [Automated Updates & Dynamic ETA](https://linehaul.ai/): LoadCognition GPT model for conversational updates and recalibrated arrival times.
- [API Integration](https://linehaul.ai/): Seamless integration between Linehaul.ai systems and customer software.
